title: Durability under a failing filesystem
note: Every claim this package makes about surviving a crash rests on three lines of write path: a write whose result is checked, an fsync that must succeed before anything independent claims the record is durable, and a temp-then-rename that leaves either nothing or a complete file. None of them had a fault behind them until tests/test_agent_fault_injection.py existed -- the suite exercised the happy path of the write and then reasoned about crashes by discarding projections. F1-F3 attack the log's write path, F4-F5 the content-addressed store's, F6 the checkpoint's. F7 attacks the ordering that makes the witness meaningful: a witness written before the data is durable is a witness that lies in exactly the situation it exists for.

mutations.name: F1_the_log_ignores_a_short_write
mutations.rationale: half a record reaches the disk, the witness is advanced to name it, and the log's independent witness now claims a record that is not there

mutations.name: F2_the_log_swallows_a_write_failure
mutations.rationale: ENOSPC becomes a successful append: the caller is told the event is recorded and the bytes are not there

mutations.name: F3_the_log_swallows_a_failed_fsync
mutations.rationale: EIO from the device is discarded, and a record that may never reach the platter is recorded as durable

mutations.name: F4_the_witness_is_advanced_before_the_data_is_durable
mutations.find:
fh.flush()
            os.fsync(fh.fileno())
            end = fh.tell()
        self._write_head(ChainState(ev.seq, ev.hash))
mutations.replace:
fh.flush()
            self._write_head(ChainState(ev.seq, ev.hash))
            os.fsync(fh.fileno())
            end = fh.tell()
mutations.rationale: the witness exists to detect a log that lost its tail; written first, it names records the log never durably had, and reports TRUNCATED after every ordinary power loss

mutations.name: F5_the_blob_store_ignores_a_short_write
mutations.rationale: a prefix of the content is published under the digest of the whole, and the store's one invariant -- what is there hashes to its name -- is broken permanently

mutations.name: F6_a_failed_blob_write_leaves_its_temporary_file
mutations.find:
os.replace(tmp, blob)
        except BaseException:
            tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
mutations.rationale: every failed write leaves a partial file in the store directory, and a store that accumulates debris on a full disk fills the disk it is already failing on

mutations.name: F7_a_failed_checkpoint_write_leaves_its_temporary_file
mutations.find:
os.replace(tmp, path)
        except BaseException:
            tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
mutations.rationale: same debris, in the directory whose file names are how checkpoints are found

mutations.name: F8_a_corrupt_checkpoint_escapes_as_a_generic_error
mutations.rationale: the failure escapes past every caller written to handle this module's errors, and audit() -- whose contract is that it never stops -- stops

mutations.name: F9_a_partial_trailing_line_is_read_as_the_end_of_the_log
mutations.rationale: a partial trailing line would be silently treated as the end of the log in strict mode too; re-anchored after D-2026-50 inverted this branch

mutations.name: F10_a_checkpoint_altered_in_place_is_restored_anyway
mutations.rationale: bit-rot inside a complete record is invisible to the parser, so this is the only check between altered bytes and a projection restored as though it had been verified
